title: DemoteIssueOnMainOptions keeps the vestigial `writeFile?` field (copied from th…
description:
DemoteIssueOnMainOptions keeps the vestigial `writeFile?` field (copied from the close/abandon siblings) even though the commitTreeToMain ref-only path never invokes it. It is a harmless interface-compat carryover, consistent with its siblings, so no action required; a future cleanup could drop it across all four writers together.

Source: cam/issue-206
Review round: 1
Location: src/commands/issue-specify.ts:588

suggestion-fingerprint: 14dcde36bac0

spec.scope: Drop the vestigial writeFile? option field from all FIVE on-main issue-mutation writer Options interfaces in src/commands/issue-specify.ts (the suggestion undercounted as four; merge was missed), and remove the three now-obsolete test injections that only asserted it was never called. Dead-code cleanup (prod + test), no behavior change; all writers keep committing via the commitTreeToMain ref-only path.
acceptanceCriteria: writeFile? is removed from all five Options interfaces in src/commands/issue-specify.ts: SpecifyIssueOnMainOptions (:93), AbandonIssueOnMainOptions (:201), MergeIssueOnMainOptions (:242), CloseIssueOnMainOptions (:518), DemoteIssueOnMainOptions (:587). No writer body referenced the field (it was already dead after the commitTreeToMain cutover).

The three obsolete tests in test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts that injected a writeFile recorder purely to assert writtenFiles has length 0 are removed/adjusted so the suite compiles against the narrowed types: the specify test (:439 injection, :448 assertion), the abandon test (:873, :879), and the demote test (:991, :997). Remove the injected recorder and its writtenFiles length assertion.

No production change beyond the interface lines: the production wrappers defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn/defaultDemoteIssueFn (src/commands/post-merge.ts:365/383/402) already pass only cwd/id/spawnFn/clock and never supplied writeFile.

No behavior change: every writer still commits via commitTreeToMain ref-only; the remaining commit-to-main assertions in those tests still pass and continue to cover the ref-only invariant. No replacement ref-only test is added (the writeFile-never-called assertion was tautological).
bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all all green.
gotchas: Five independent copy-pasted declarations, no shared base (no `extends`): removal is FIVE separate edits, one per interface line, not one.

Removing the field narrows the types, so the three test call sites that pass writeFile WILL NOT COMPILE unless their injected recorder AND writtenFiles length-0 assertion are removed in the SAME change. Do both together.

Do NOT add a replacement ref-only/working-tree test: the removed assertions were tautological; the real invariant (writer commits to main, does not dirty the working tree) is already covered by the existing commit-to-main assertions in the same tests.
mergeIssueOnMain and closeIssueOnMain tests never passed writeFile, so only three test sites need touching; do not hunt for a fourth/fifth test injection.
